title: Latvian Fire Stations
description: The European Command is helping Latvia provide better emergency services.  Eight cities across Latvia are getting brand new fire stations, thanks to the U.S. European Command’s Humanitarian and Civic Engagement Program.  Soundbites include Mr. Mark Pekala - U.S. Ambassador to Latvia and Mr. Brian Trzaska - Resident Engineer, U.S. Army Corps of Engineers, Europe District.  Produced by SSGT. Tristan McIntire.  Also available in High Definition.
